One roof on
Philadelphia St.

A natural-hair salon and a barbershop sharing one floor in downtown York: retwists and locs, braids and press-and-curl on one side; cuts, fades, lineups and razor shaves on the other. Every photo in the book below is work done in these chairs, and the floor's Google rating is a perfect 5.0 across 28 reviews.

what's done here

Services

The services on the salon's own listing, plus the work its chairs post every week. Prices are not published anywhere, so call the salon for yours.

The Salon Side
RetwistThe house specialty+
The listing's headline offering and the work that fills the gallery: retwists finished as barrel twists, two-strand twists and styled locs.
Press and CurlSilk-press styling+
Press and curl, on the salon's published offering list: natural hair pressed smooth and curled, finished in the chair.
BraidsDone at the braiding station+
Braiding is filmed at this salon's stations: clients in the chair, racks of hair at the mirror, work in progress on the salon floor.
StyleTwists, coils and finishes+
Styling on the published list, and all over the gallery: comb coils, two-strand twists and finished looks, for adults and kids alike.
The Barber Side
CutFades and lineups+
Cuts on the listing, with the gallery to prove the range: fades, crisp lineups and finished work on clients of every age, kids included.
Razor ShaveThe baldie, done right+
The razor shave is a published offering here, and the gallery's signature shot: a clean baldie with a shaped full beard, caped at the station.
